Good video and assuming that the next big console is indeed free of any physical medium: There is going to be a nasty logistic point of view, not for the users, but for the retailers.

Here is the thing, game retailers not only profit from the sell of the console, but also from accessories AND games.

If you sell a console that will create them money only once (killing in the process any second hand market), there is a good chance that retailers will not be promoting this console as they will promote other consoles that let them keep making money of these mentioned revenues. Not only that, but since retailers will not longer promote their games (why would they?) this could also mean that even the software side will lose significant "visibility" in certain markets.

How big this is, is it even significant? Hard to tell at this point and most likely irrelevant if the console becomes really successful (a la Wii), but if the console will struggle (a la Wii U), then this sort of deal could hurt very bad.
